opis: The grassy glade from the reference picture at NIGHT: a deep dark-blue starry sky, a smiling crescent moon, the big oak with a little round lit window on the left, everything in soft blue moonlight. In the middle of the sky over the glade HUNDREDS of tiny glowing yellow-green FIREFLIES dance in a big swirling ribbon, loops and spirals of little lights, some coming down low over the grass. In the front on the grass stand the FOX, the SQUIRREL, the OWL and the ROE DEER side by side, seen a little from behind and the side, looking up at the dance with delight; each holds a small glass jar lantern glowing warm yellow with one firefly inside. The SQUIRREL laughs with her paws raised - she is not afraid of the dark any more. Magical, calm and joyful.
